description: This file defines the 'UserMenuConfigurator' class responsible for configuring user menu entries within the OrangeHRM admin module. It implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface and overrides the 'configure' method to set the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers'.

classes.name: UserMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures user menu options within the OrangeHRM admin interface by implementing the MenuConfigurator interface and setting the screen to 'viewSystemUsers'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default configure method to set the current screen to 'viewSystemUsers' for the user menu.
